headline: Indian IT services posted mixed results in Q2 FY27, with a few firms delivering strong top‑line growth while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit growth was strongest at HCLTech (21% YoY) and weakest at Wipro (‑2%). AI‑related revenue and deals were highlighted across several companies, but guidance was trimmed by Infosys and newly introduced by HCLTech and Wipro. Margin expansion was limited, with operating margins staying in the mid‑teens to low‑mid‑20s.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue rose sharply at Infosys (29% YoY), HCLTech ($219 m) and Mphasis, fueling higher profits and larger deal wins.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge and Persistent posted very high YoY growth, while Infosys and LTM showed modest increases.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%; HCLTech and Wipro introduced modest FY27 outlooks.

leaders.why: Revenue up 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.
Revenue surged 39.9% YoY, the strongest growth among reported firms.

laggards.why: Revenue growth only 1.5% YoY and profit growth slowed to 6%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and guidance is weak.
